messages:
maria: Quick sync — we need a short performance + pricing storyline for launch assets. Can we frame tradeoffs as 'fast path vs low-cost path' rather than raw latency/cost numbers? :thinking_face:

dan: I like fast-path / low-cost framing. For PR and webinar we still need one clear chart. Proposed: response time vs unit price, with simple annotations for Hosted / Dedicated / Private.

ashley: OK — I can design three visual directions: scatter (time vs $), ranked bars (tokens per $ for common workloads), and a decomposition waterfall (compute / infra / caching). Which should be the hero?

leo: For inbound routing, map enterprise -> predictable latency play, PLG / devs -> price/throughput play. That gives us two CTA funnels and different snippets for the landing page.

maria: Snappy audience-facing hooks: "Scale latency-sensitive features without breaking the bank" and "Reduce token spend without retraining" — short, benefit-first. Avoid heavy numbers in top-of-funnel.

dan: For the chart mock: axes = `x: response time (ms)`, `y: $ per 1M tokens`. Add shaded SLO bands (<=100ms, 100-300ms, >300ms). Internal copy can include absolute $ but external should use % improvements per legal. Quick mock CSV below: 
```csv
label,time_ms,$per_1M
redwood-fast,70,850
redwood-balanced,180,320
redwood-cheap,420,180
competitor-A,250,600
competitor-B,350,450
```

ashley: Nice. I'll make two variants in Figma: one with $ numbers for internal deck, one with %-only annotations for public site. Color palette: blue for fast, green for cost, grey for competitors.

leo: Legal note — avoid calling out precise competitor prices. Use relative language: "up to 2.5x cheaper" or "~40% faster". Good to have both concrete examples for sales and a scrubbed public version.

maria: Action items: dan -> generate CSV + clean chart exports (2 versions); ashley -> figma comps + hero image; leo -> inbound copy + CTA variants for two funnels. We'll need a 90s webinar demo script that shows routing switching between modes.

dan: I'll produce chart PNGs + a csv and put them in "/marketing/assets/perf-econ/3050123456" by EOD. Internal CSV will include $ numbers, public will be %-converted.

ashley: I'll push Figma frames and a short slide deck (3 slides) for the webinar. Slide 2 = chart, slide 3 = routing/CTA.

leo: Drafting CTAs now: enterprise CTA = "Request predictable capacity & SLA", dev CTA = "Try hosted API — free credits". Also adding short routing copy: "If latency-critical, choose Fast Path; if cost-critical, choose Low-Cost Path."

maria: Perfect. One more ask — can we capture a tiny three-step script for the demo: 1) send a latency-sensitive request (show fast path), 2) send a batch throughput example (show low-cost path), 3) show automatic fallback to cheaper model when capacity constrained. Keep it under 90s.

dan: Draft script in thread: 
1) Ping Fast Path -> response shown at ~70ms (highlight stable SLO).
2) Send 1k batched requests -> show throughput and lowered $/token.
3) Simulate peak -> show automatic fallback to compatible model with minor quality delta.

ashley: ok will weave that into slides and the demo checklist.

maria: Thanks all. We'll review at tomorrow's creative review (10am PT). Please mark anything you can't hit for EOD. :white_check_mark:
